slice: Pass 2: engine, clutch, Husqvarna/GasGas OEM numbers
notes: Platform ids reuse pass 1 ids from ktm-engine-clutch-cooling.json (KTM4T-*, KTM2T-*) and ktm-oem-accessories.json (ktm-4t-2023, hqv-2023, gg-2024). One new platform is added: GG-MC4T-2021-2023. Enduro models (EXC, XC-W, TE, FE, EC, ES) are left out of fits even where sources list them. Search budget: 35 of ~35 used.

platforms.description: GasGas MC 250F / MC 450F for model years 2021-2023 use the previous-generation KTM/Husqvarna 4-stroke engine (78 mm bore 250; previous 450), not the 2023+ new-generation engine. Two sources agree. Cometic's manufacturer page lists the old-generation 250 bottom-end kit C3595BE for GasGas MC 250F 2021-2023, and its 2023 MC 250F application page returns only old-generation 250 kits. Vertex's PRO Replica 450 piston is listed for GasGas MC-F 450 2021-2023 next to KTM 450 SX-F 2016-2022. This settles pass 1's open question: for 2023 GasGas MC-F, use 2016-2022 KTM 4T parts. The new-generation engine starts on GasGas with MY2024.
Reused from pass 1 (81 mm bore 250 SX-F, 2023+). GasGas MC 250F joins from MY2024 (see GG-MC4T-2021-2023).

part_numbers: Cycle Gear item P1152564 (retailer item, not a Pro X MPN)

Also MC 250F Factory Edition 2025 and EX 250F 2024-2025

products.caveats: This extends pass 1's Pro X fitment to 2027. The canonical URL says 2023-2025 while the title and fitment list say 2023-2027. No Pro X MPN is shown on the page.

products.variants: Blue, red. Thread size not stated.

Only 2023+ captured. Also MC 250F Factory Edition 2023-2024.

products.product: Moose Racing Aluminum Magnetic Drain Plug KTM / Husqvarna 50cc-501cc
products.what_it_changes: 7075 aluminium, clear anodised, magnet pulls metal filings from the oil (manufacturer claim). Safety-wire drilled.
products.supporting_parts: Ships with an O-ring or a metal washer.

products.product: Rekluse RadiusX 4.0 (DDS) Clutch Kit, KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas 250-300 2T 2023+
products.what_it_changes: Rekluse claims (via retailer): no stalling, so starts and stops work without the lever; more power transfer than OEM; on-the-fly external adjustment; allows taller gearing; TorqDrive pack lasts longer and needs less adjustment. The manual lever still works as an override.
products.supporting_parts: Professional installation recommended by the retailer.
products.service_implications: Rekluse-specific frictions. The 'DDS' in the retailer title means it is built for KTM's Belleville-spring clutch (see p2-ktm-dds-clutch-notes).

where_to_buy.seller: RevZilla (US), listed as 'Radius X 4.0 KTM/Husqvarna 250-300 2023-2027' (assumed same kit)

products.caveats: The ORO2U title says '250-350' and covers 2024 4T enduro models, so one SKU spanning 2T MX and 4T enduro is odd; verify on the Rekluse fitment tool. RevZilla shows no MPN or price.

part_numbers: Cycle Gear item P1067617 (retailer item, not a Hinson MPN)

products.product: Hinson Racing Clutch Plate and Spring Kit (KTM 450 SX-F 2013-2024; KTM 300 SX 2023-2026)
part_numbers: FSC373-8-002 (taken from retailer SKU strings 'H|1629-FSC373-8-002|15' and '...|60'; the 'manufacturer part number' field shows only '8')
products.what_it_changes: Made to close tolerances to mate with a Hinson basket, which Hinson says improves basket and plate life. Works in OEM or Hinson basket, hub and pressure plate (retailer copy).
products.supporting_parts: Coil springs only work with a coil-spring pressure plate (Hinson kit). KTM's stock DDS uses a single diaphragm spring (see p2-ktm-dds-clutch-notes), so the springs in this kit imply the Hinson conversion. Inferred, not stated.
products.caveats: The same SKU stem covers a 450 SX-F from 2013 and a 2023+ 300 SX 2-stroke, so retailer data may be generic. The part number is not confirmed by Hinson.

products.product: Oberon hydraulic clutch slave (pusher) cylinder CLU-7923
products.variants: Black, Blue, Orange, Titanium (seven colours claimed)
products.what_it_changes: Oberon claims (via retailer): improved plunger/piston design against leaks, smoother action, guided piston for less wear and softer lever feel, lower lever effort. CNC T6 aluminium, Viton U-profile seals, 100 g.
products.supporting_parts: Complete kit with instructions. Replaces OEM 79232061044 / 25032061044 / 72132061044.
products.service_implications: Use the fluid marked on the clutch master cylinder: mineral oil (Magura) or DOT 4 (Brembo). The unit accepts both.
products.caveats: The retailer's list has visible typos (e.g. 'EXC 250 2017-2014'). Husqvarna stops at 2022 while KTM and GasGas run to 2024/2025, which is odd for a shared part. 2025+ KTM and 2023+ Husqvarna not listed. Verify with Oberon.

products.product: KTM DS and DDS diaphragm-spring clutch: background and service notes
part_numbers: Rekluse DDS kits RMS-7084 (Core Manual), RMS-7785 (Core EXP), RMS-335 (cover)
products.variants: DDS = damped diaphragm steel (rubber cush dampers in hub, steel basket with integral primary gear, single Belleville spring). DS = same without dampers.

fits.notes: MXA, Feb 2019. Which clutch the 2023+ engines use was NOT verified in this pass.

products.what_it_changes: Explains why coil-spring aftermarket springs (Barnett, Hinson) are not a drop-in on stock KTM clutches: KTM uses one diaphragm spring that self-adjusts and spreads pressure evenly. Rubber dampers on DDS absorb shock.
products.service_implications: MXA replaces DDS rubber bumpers about every 4 months. Rekluse (RMS-7082 install doc) cites KTM's interval of 20 h (SX-F) / 30 h (XC/EXC) for damper checks: replace if the inner hub has slop. DDS uses thinner end steels, so keep the plate order. Rekluse says to use fresh JASO-MA oil and not to reuse stock pressure-plate screws with their kit.

rider_feedback.author: MXA staff
rider_feedback.summary: Says the billet DDS basket should never need replacing for notching; bumpers wear and get replaced about every four months on their test bikes.

products.caveats: The Rekluse doc covers the 2013+ 250/350 SX-F CSS-to-DDS conversion (older generation). Retailers label the 2023+ 2T RadiusX kit 'DDS', which suggests 2023+ 2-strokes still use DDS, but this is unconfirmed. Source: https://www.rekluse.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/RMS-7082.pdf

products.product: Husqvarna Factory Racing Triple Clamps (Blue) 2023

products.caveats: Search title only, and the page is gone, so the part may be discontinued or superseded. The '68' colour code matches the older Husqvarna clamp 2620199902168, which suggests 68 is the Husqvarna blue suffix (inferred).

gaps: Wiseco: no 2023+ part number found for the 250 SX-F (81 mm) or 2023+ 125/250/300 TBI two-strokes. Search results returned only pre-2023 Wiseco listings, and wiseco.com fetch was blocked (https://www.wiseco.com/search?q=250%20sx-f%202023).
JE: only 'JE Pistons KTM 450SX-F Piston Kit' SKU JEP260955 (Coyote Direct, USD 309.99, backordered) found, with no years, bore or compression, so it was not recorded. CP Carrillo: nothing found.
Vertex/Athena high-compression or big-bore kits for 2023+ 4T engines: none found. Only the old-generation Vertex PRO Replica 450 (12.6:1) was recorded.
Hot Cams / Web Cams for 2023+ engines: none found. All Hot Cams hits were 2016-2022 250 (already in pass 1).
Kibblewhite / Del West: no 2023+ KTM listing found. Parts Europe pages need JavaScript and returned nothing.
Crank/rod kits (Hot Rods, Pro X, Vertex) for 2020+ in-scope MX models: none found (only 50 SX and pre-2015 Vertex kits).
Athena gasket kits for 2023+: not found. Cometic 2023+ KTM numbers not captured (KTM 250 SX-F 2024 application page blocked: https://www.cometic.com/applications/powersports/ktm/250-sx-f/2024).
Stators (Ricky Stator / Rick's, Electrosport) for 2023+ MX: none found. Hits were 2013-2022 or OEM 79239004100 (2015-2020 4T) and 55439004000 (2017-2020 250 SX).
4-stroke flywheel weights for 2023+: none found. Steahly 2T 2023 (pass 1) remains the only flywheel weight.
Barnett springs/plates for 2023+ KTM: none found (only 2011-2018 kits). Note: stock KTM DS/DDS clutches use a diaphragm spring, so coil-spring kits only apply with a coil-spring pressure plate.
hinsonracing.com was not reached (the Hinson search returned only retailers). Hinson numbers HCA460-2301 / HCA480-2301 come from retailers.

Rekluse: no rekluse.com fitment page reached. RadiusX numbers come from UK retailers (RMS-8313186, RMS-8313198). The RMS number for the RadiusCX 4.0 450 (Cycle Gear P1069732) was not found, and no RadiusX/CX 250/350 4T 2023+ kit number was captured.

Husqvarna 2023+ CUO part number, GasGas CUO part number, Husqvarna/GasGas start device, skid plate and Hinson cover variants: not found. The GasGas search returned only press articles. Husqvarna 2024 Rockstar Edition press kit confirms Factory triple clamps (20/22 mm), black Factory wheels, holeshot device, 2K carbon skid plate, CUO + GPS and map switch are standard, but gives no part numbers: https://www.husqvarna-motorcycles.com/language-masters/en/media-information/factory-edition-2024/2024-FC-250-450-Rockstar-Edition-Press-Kit.pdf
Husqvarna blue Factory wheels for 2023+: no part number found.
Oberon CLU-4050 found but its fitment is 2014-2016 Husqvarna (out of scope), so it was not recorded.
